sources.quote: Generative AI is used solely during development for supplemental, non-essential purposes, including unit testing or the creation of certain art elements. These AI-generated outputs are limited in scope, reviewed by our development team, and never substituted human creative or technical decision-making. All final core assets and game content are created entirely by Wargaming’s artists and developers.

coverageLimits: Qoder WebSearch 每次返回 4-6 条结果，检索范围限于工具实际返回的内容，不代表全网没有报道。
第三方 AI 披露聚合站（AI Transparency Index / Steam AI Filter / GameAICheck / HowMuchAI）的正文是对 Steam 商店披露的转录或模型再分类，登记为已读来源但不构成独立核实。
Reddit、Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 与部分转载页经 GitHub Actions 中转抓取返回 HTTP 403 或只返回壳页，正文不可读，只能作为线索登记。
本批十款均未检索到独立于商店披露的核实性报道（如审计、逐素材取证或开发者实名访谈），所有领域判定仍以开发者自述为准。
